A1.justification: Both complete ten-page PDFs describe the same LaMAGIC2 work, with readable and matchable text, equations, figures, tables, and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: Sections 5–6 report original training and NGSPICE simulation results, including baseline comparisons, transfer experiments, and ablations in Figures 5–8 and Tables 2–5.

after.justification: Sections 5–6 retain the original training, simulation, transfer, and ablation results reported in v1.

M1.justification: The SFM and SFCI procedures in Section 4 are unchanged, including numeric encoding, duty-cycle selection, identifiers, and component-type tokens. Correcting SCFI to SFCI does not alter the method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate 3-, 4-, and 5-component power converters and transfer to 6-component circuits. The transistor-based inverter in Section 6.4 remains an illustrative future extension, not an additional evaluated domain.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: CF, PM, and FM participate in the formulation comparisons, while RL-search and o1 participate in the separate 350-specification comparison.

E3.justification: Both retain the same data splits, 500/1000/2000-example transfer settings, 350-specification RL/o1 comparison, training configuration, tolerance thresholds, and MSE calculations, including treatment of invalid circuits.

E4.justification: The duty-cycle-prefix and component-type-token ablations in Sections 6.1–6.2, transfer analysis in Section 5.3, and computational-efficiency analysis in Section 6.3 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random-seed values, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5 and the result plots retain identical token lengths, success rates, and MSEs. Section 6.3 also retains the same convergence counts of 8,943 steps for SFM and 6,886 for SFCI; no result entries or findings change.

T1.justification: The hypergraph definitions, autoregressive objective, and incidence-count derivation of O(|V|) output length in Section 4.2 are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about linear token length, numeric precision, generation performance, and transferability. The new code pointer does not change these scientific claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning attention dilution, component-type recognition, and duty-cycle-prefix benefits are unchanged. Both retain the same future directions involving search-based decoding and transistor-based circuits.

D1.justification: V2 adds an explicit code-availability statement and a LaMAGIC repository link to the abstract, absent from v1. Implementation details, hardware, and hyperparameters otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged, including the relationships to LaMAGIC, search-based methods, and AnalogCoder. No related-work citation is added or removed.

P1.justification: V2 corrects several SCFI misspellings to SFCI in Sections 6.4 and 7 and adds the short code-availability sentence. Section order and the remaining narrative are unchanged.

P2.justification: The opening pages undergo minor reflow, and Figure 2 changes the hypergraph nodes' outline and fill styling. All nine figures and five tables remain, with unchanged scientific content.

improvement.justification: The added repository pointer improves code-access information, and the acronym corrections modestly improve terminology consistency. These are limited benefits: the scientific evidence, methodological detail, and conclusions remain unchanged, and the PDFs alone do not establish the linked code's usability.
